oldRow.title: Inconsistent output formatting for glob results over 200 matches
oldRow.detail: When matches.length > 200, the result contains only the first 200 formatted files plus a note about more files (line 89), but NO header line like 'N files matched:' (which only appears in the else branch at line 91). This creates inconsistent output: small result sets start with 'N files matched:' but large result sets do not. Additionally, line 89 uses '... and X more files' which should use singular 'file' when X=1.
oldRow.fix: Always prepend the match count header regardless of count. Move line 91's header before the conditional, or build the header after the conditional logic.

distinction: Old123 is producer >200 missing header and singular/plural inconsistency. New lead is current CLI/TUI consumer treating ordinary serialized header/no-match status as file rows; occurs with1positive or0 matches, independent of >200 producer formatting. Fixing producer to always prepend header leaves CLI count wrong.
